deviations.plan: measure e_L(h) with a single-layer edit at unit strength c = 1
deviations.done: c = 2.5 (width 1), chosen on DEV before the freeze
deviations.why: at c = 1 a single layer moved judged refusal by at most 0.05 and at c = 1.5 by 0.10, below the 0.15 pilot threshold the plan's fallback names; c = 2.5 reached 0.65 with 0.00 degenerate output, so the profile has a measurable dynamic range without buying it with incoherence
deviations.cost: the profile is a c = 2.5 object: e_L(h) is the write effect AT THAT DOSE, and the 1.0/1.5 pilot cells are kept as the dose-sensitivity record

deviations.done: single-layer probes at c = 2.5 and some matched-energy cells above 1.5
deviations.why: 1.5 is an optimiser search bound, not a property of the operator; the matched-energy design needs whatever scale reaches the target energy on 12 layers
deviations.cost: cells above the bound are outside the region Heretic's own search explores; each one carries its scale in results/cells/<cell>/meta.json

deviations.plan: re-measure the shipped edit, the swapped kernel and the no-op
deviations.done: their iteration-3 generations are RE-LABELLED here, not regenerated; only the two energy-matched twins A3/A4 were generated
deviations.why: same model revision, same quantisation, same items, same token budget, same batching code path; regenerating them would have cost ~20 GPU-minutes and produced the same strings
deviations.cost: the A1/A2 rows inherit the iteration-3 run's numerics; GATE 3 reproduced a stored no-op cell at 0.9166666666666666 first-60-character agreement and an edited cell at 0.7083333333333334, which is the size of the batch/numerics drift this family has already documented

deviations.plan: the DEV argmax names the winning band out of sample
deviations.done: the profile is measured here on DEV items only, but the iteration-3 screen had already shown that band 25-36 removes the most Slovene refusal at c = 1 in this checkpoint
deviations.why: the two panels share a model and a direction family; that ordering was visible before this pod ran, so the band prediction is CORROBORATION, not a surprise
deviations.cost: the genuinely out-of-sample tests are the rank ordering of O over the strided and hybrid cells (which no prior panel measured), the A1-A4 ladder and the mis-specification screen; the band check is reported but is not the load-bearing claim

deviations.plan: RefusEU official guard pipeline (Llama-Guard-3-8B + PolyGuard) ASR
deviations.done: not run: no S5/S5X generation was produced in this pod
deviations.why: the GPU budget went to the 48-layer profile and the 28 new confirmation cells; the S5X paired secondary was the declared cut-order item that fell
deviations.cost: attack success is reported only as judged COMPLIED (+ PARTIAL for the broad reading), which is an upper bound on a guard-scored ASR and is labelled as such

deviations.done: over-refusal is measured on the 40 held-out-category HARMLESS twins instead (S6 was never opened; it is a reserved final-evaluation split)
deviations.why: the frozen data protocol reserves S6/S7 for the evaluation artifact
deviations.cost: the over-refusal read is on safety-adjacent twins of the harmful items, not on XSTest

deviations.done: measured within edited arms: SL kappa 0.8297749567224466, EN kappa 0.7212622088655147; confirmatory ['sl'], JUDGE_SENSITIVE ['en']
deviations.why: the local judge is the only affordable scorer for ~10k generations
deviations.cost: every rate in a JUDGE_SENSITIVE language is a judge-dependent range, reported beside its Rogan-Gladen correction, and is blocked from confirmatory reading

deviations.plan: the frozen threshold reads 'Spearman(O_SL, strict SL residual) >= 0.6'
deviations.done: evaluated on the removal-aligned statistic -rho; both are printed side by side
deviations.why: e_L(h) is a refusal DROP, so O predicts REMOVAL and its expected sign against SURVIVING refusal is negative; the frozen sentence omitted the sign
deviations.cost: none numerically - the threshold is applied to |rho| with the predicted direction checked separately - but it is a post-freeze clarification and is recorded as one

deviations.plan: buy a stratified 600-item gpt-4.1 certification inside this pod (cap $3.00) before any confirmatory reading
deviations.done: NOT bought: the platform's shared OpenRouter key returned aii_openrouter_key_limit for every call; $0.00 spent. Certification fell back to the gpt-4.1 labels already on disk for GaMS3 EDITED arms (iteration-2 cells, same pinned judge and rubric)
deviations.why: the key's daily limit is shared across every run on the platform and was exhausted at 19:47 UTC
deviations.cost: the certification is measured on DIFFERENT cells than this pod's own, so it bounds the judge's agreement rather than measuring it on these generations; Slovene passes the 0.80 gate (0.8297749567224466) and English misses it (0.7212622088655147), so English is blocked from confirmatory reading

deviations.plan: the dissociation ladder A1-A4 separates placement from dose
deviations.done: four extra cells (P_ship/P_swap at E3 and E2) were added AFTER the freeze
deviations.why: A1-A4 all sit at the refusal floor (judged Slovene strict 0.00-0.20), so the ladder cannot resolve placement at production dose; the added rungs put both production kernels at the two matched energies where the panel is not saturated
deviations.cost: they are exploratory, are marked so in configs/post_freeze_cells.json, never enter the primary statistic and never enter the Holm family
